title: Pure Chaos Erupts After Handcuffed Teen Flees from Police Car

On March 17, 2021, a large crowd of young adults was enjoying their spring break in Clearwater, FL. As police were in the area, the crowd became unruly and a fight broke out, resulting in several arrests. When one of the suspects was placed in the backseat of the squad car, an uninvolved individual opened the backseat door and let the suspect escape while handcuffed.
